Why You Need an AI Video Prompt Agent
Camera Logic
AI video models fail without direction. Our Agent automatically adds camera movements like 'Dolly In', 'Truck Left', or 'FPV Drone' to give your video cinematic dynamism.
Physics & Motion
Avoid the 'AI morphing' effect. We optimize prompts to define clear physical actions (e.g., 'running without sliding', 'water splashing naturally') for Veo 3's physics engine.
Style Locking
Want a consistent look? The Agent can generate prompts that strictly adhere to specific art styles like '1980s VHS', 'Pixar 3D', or 'Nano Banana Flat Illustration'.
Negative Prompting
It's not just what you want, but what you don't. The Agent automatically includes negative parameters to prevent common video glitches like extra limbs or blurry backgrounds.
Flux Kontext Integration
Go beyond text. The Prompt Agent works seamlessly with Flux Kontext to incorporate character references into the video prompt, ensuring your protagonist looks the same in every clip.
Commercial Ready
Generate prompts optimized for high-resolution, watermark-free outputs suitable for advertising, YouTube, and professional presentations.
AI Video Prompt Generator: Craft Cinematic Prompts for Veo 3 & Sora

Stop wasting credits on bad video generations. Lovart's AI Agent acts as your personal cinematographer, transforming simple ideas into highly detailed, technically optimized video prompts. Unlock the full potential of Veo 3 and Kling with precise camera control, lighting, and motion directives.
Describe your video idea (e.g., A cyberpunk detective walking in rain)

Generate Pro Prompt
Turn Vague Ideas into Hollywood Scenes
Describe Your Vision
Start with a rough concept. Whether it's 'a car driving' or 'a fantasy battle', just type what you see in your mind. No need to know technical film jargon.
Agentic Enhancement
The Lovart Agent analyzes your input and injects professional cinematography details—camera lenses, lighting types, and motion physics—optimized specifically for models like Veo 3.
Generate & Iterate
Use the enhanced prompt to generate stunning videos instantly within Lovart. Not satisfied? Ask the Agent to 'make it scarier' or 'zoom in closer' to refine the result.

Concept Artist
Does this work for all AI video models?
Yes, Lovart's Prompt Agent is trained on the syntax of major models like Veo 3, Kling, Sora, and Runway Gen-3. It adjusts the terminology to fit the specific model you choose.
Do I need to know photography terms?
Not at all. You describe the feeling (e.g., 'scary', 'fast', 'dreamy'), and the Agent translates that into technical camera terms (e.g., 'Dutch angle', 'Motion blur', 'Soft focus').
Can I use images as prompts for video?
Yes! This is our 'Image-to-Video' workflow. Upload a Nano Banana image, and the Agent will help you write a motion prompt to bring that static image to life effortlessly.
How detailed should my initial idea be?
It can be as simple as three words or as complex as a paragraph. The Agent is designed to expand on simple ideas or refine complex ones for better AI interpretation.
Is the Prompt Generator free?
Basic prompt enhancement is available to all users. Advanced features like Flux Kontext integration and unlimited prompt iterations are part of the Pro plan.
